origin: Derived from exploratory S001 event-subtype analysis; not independent on SPY.

rule.negativeEventGap: 09:30 ET open <= prior RTH close by at least 0.20%
rule.vwapFailure: A bar closes below session VWAP after its high reaches within 0.10% of VWAP.
rule.priceConfirmation: The next 5-minute bar remains below VWAP and closes below the failure-bar close.

crossAssetAdvanceGate: Both diagnostic assets must pass individually with unchanged thresholds.
interpretationLimit: Cross-asset diagnostic only. A pass does not establish SPY options profitability or justify live trading.
antiOverfitRule: No thresholds or event-type membership may be changed after diagnostic data are inspected.
